title: Mason Jars 16 oz with Airtight Lids and Bands, 15 Pack Regular Mouth Canning Jars, Clear Glass Pint Jars for Canning, Pickling, Food Storage, DIY Projects, 24 Labels, Brush & String Included
description:
About this item
Food Grade Glass: The mason jars 16 oz with lids are made of high-quality food grade glass, BPA-free and lead-free, durable and sturdy for daily use. The transparent wall allows you to clearly distinguish what is inside. Note: The jars are safe for dishwasher and microwave but without the lid. To freeze, fill up to 12 oz.
Tight Seal & Leakproof: The silver split-type lid of canning jars consists of a screw band and a flat metal disc with a silicone sealing ring on the rim, which can tightly seal the jar mouth and prevent air and excessive moisture in. No leakage, No spill, and keep fresh for longer!
Use & Clean Easily: These pint canning jars with a 2.59" diameter regular mouth are easy to fill or empty drinks, fruits, veggies, herbs, sauces and spices. Dishware safe makes them have no trouble cleaning up, and It's also convenient to clean all corners of the jars by hand with our bonus sponge brush.
Multipurpose Mason Jars: They are the perfect containers for Canning sauce, jam, honey, overnight oats, soup and drinks, Pickling vegetables, fruit and salads, Storing spices, herbs, snacks, dry goods and sewing items. Also great for vases, homemade candles or DIY decor. Idea as wedding favors, shower favors or other homemade gifts.
Set Includes: The package comes with 15 pack 16oz empty glass mason jars, 15 silver screw lids and bands, 24 labels to mark, 1 bundle of string for decor, and 1 sponge brush for easy clean. All of them are securely packaged in a foam barrier to ensure you receive a good one.

reviews_1s:
I should have read some of the reviews before purchasing these jars. I was suspicious when I unpacked them as to whether or not they could actually be used for canning. The rings do not fit properly and the lids don't seal properly. I used a water bath to can marinara sauce and two rings and seals were completely off at the end of the process. Additionally, two more rings are partially lifted. The space between the sauce and the top of the jar was carefully measured, the seals were on and rings were finger tight. Huge loss of sauce, resources and time. Live and learn. I will not purchase anything except American made canning jars such as Kerr, Ball or Mason from now on. I have never had this kind of issue with this amount of sauce in all of my years of canning. What a mess.The packaging was good while the accessories were fine and nothing was damaged, that being said 6 out of the 15 lids for the jars would not screw back on correctly when I took a lid that was screwing on a jar correctly and try it on the one that wasn't working correct that lid wouldn't screw on to that jar however the lids that wouldn't screw on to the defective jar did screw on to some of the others So very poor quality control don't waste your time nothing but frustrationThese are not Mason jars. And standard rings/lids do not fit them!breaks easily. came brokenCanned 8 jars of stew yesterday with these jars. Not one sealed! The lids appear to be slightly too big for the mouth of the jar and the rings do not fit properly. What a mess! Expensive lesson learned! Gave 1 star only because I had to.Everything arrived, packaged well, but every lid came in with rust on them. I would not recommend.Not Mason jars, Chinese, smaller than Mason or Ball. I washed the lids with actual Mason jars. Tried the Chinese lid, but a fraction TOO SMALL to fit standard canning jars. I am furious.
